title: Universal closedness descends along a flat surjective morphism of affine schemes
statement: Let $S$ and $S'$ be affine schemes [def-pc-scheme], let $g:S'\to S$ be flat and surjective [def-weil-flat-morphism] [def-weil-surjective-morphism], and let $f:X\to S$ be a morphism. If the second projection $X\times_SS'\to S'$ of the fibre product [def-pc-fibre-product] is universally closed [def-weil-proper-morphism], then $f$ is universally closed.
